# Imposia 0.7.0

Imposia 0.7.0 moves more of the preview pipeline into the library, so hosts stop
patching generated DOM: resolve elements before pagination, fail strictly on
missing resources, export the committed pages as standalone HTML, and start
preparation when the host wants it. There are no breaking changes.

## Highlights

- **Resource policy.** `blockedResourcePolicy: "error"` fails a generation with
  `RESOURCE_BLOCKED` before commit and keeps the previous document.
- **Element resolvers.** `elements` replaces the text, HTML, or image of
  elements matched by CSS selectors, with async data, before pagination.
  `assetFromDataUrl()` decodes base64 data URLs. Failures surface as
  `ELEMENT_RESOLUTION_FAILED`.
- **HTML export.** `exportPageDocumentHtml()` returns the committed pages as one
  standalone HTML string with resolved assets inlined.
- **Font loading.** `fontLoading: { mode: "unicode-range" }` skips font faces
  the document cannot use; generated quotation marks keep every face.
- **iframe title.** `iframeTitle` names the canonical iframe, and the Viewer no
  longer overwrites it.
- **Viewer policy.** `fit`, `zoomable`, and `keyboard` are independent options.
- **React.** `preparation` (`immediate`, `idle`, `manual`), `prepare()`,
  `retry()`, and `source` on the ready state.
- **Tables.** Rows with a blank spacer pseudo split, `break-inside: avoid` rows
  try the next fragment first, and split rows keep their column widths.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/EungyuCho/imposia/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
